body:
I heard about this new herb called mulungu that's supposed to be something like kava, so I decided to buy online and try it out.
Recipe: Two tablespoons (maybe half an ounce) of Mulungu into 1.25 cups of boiling water. Covered and boiled about two minutes. Smells great, very cinnamon-y Took off heat, still covered, and steeped about three minutes.
Downed the either thing after it cooled down.  The taste was nice, very much like tea.  Immediate upon drinking I felt a slight relaxation.  It graduately got stronger and peaked after maybe 20 minutes, peaking for another 3 hours and tapering off after that.
The effects were similar to valium or kava- basically mellowed out and sedated with some euphoria.  About as strong as 10mg of valium.  Slight coordination loss, nothing major.
Conclusion:  Great stuff, I'll definitely do it again.  No hangover effects at all.  Because of the pleasant taste, I'd rate it higher than kava.  It would certainly make a useful sleep aid and anxiety-reducer, maybe even a decent substitute for alcohol or kava.
